Key it by runner OS and the best available checked-in dependency inputs (lockfiles when present; otherwise dependency manifests, Makefile/install declarations and workflow setup). Cache only dependency download state, use exact keys without broad restore fallbacks, and always run every original install and test command on cache hits. Do not skip work based on cache-hit outputs. For timeout patterns change only job timeout-minutes, using baseline evidence with headroom. Do not add networking/deploy/publish/secret usage or replace action versions. The baseline already passed the required checks. Keep the change narrow so those same commands still run and can pass; the measured CI runs determine whether the candidate succeeds and whether it helps. If the method has a limitation, record it in rationale but still implement the closest valid version of the selected method. Return ONLY JSON: {pattern_id, decision: APPLY, rationale, workflow_yaml}. workflow_yaml must contain the complete changed file.

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [ master, github ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      matrix:
        php-versions: ['8.1', '8.2', '8.3', '8.4', '8.5']

    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v7

    - name: Start mysql
      run: |
        sudo systemctl start mysql
        sudo systemctl status mysql.service
        sudo journalctl -xeu mysql.service
        mysql -V

    - name: Prepare the application
      run: |
        DBHOST_FLAG=
        [ -S /var/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock ] || DBHOST_FLAG="--host=127.0.0.1"
        sudo lib/createdb.sh -u root -proot $DBHOST_FLAG -c test/options.php --batch
        sudo lib/createdb.sh -u root -proot $DBHOST_FLAG -c test/cdb-options.php --no-dbuser --no-schema --batch

    - name: Set up PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
      with:
        php-version: ${{ matrix.php-versions }}
        extensions: mbstring, intl, mysqlnd
        ini-values: opcache.enable_cli=1

    - name: Install poppler
      run: |
        sudo apt-get --fix-broken install
        sudo apt-get install poppler-utils || ( sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install poppler-utils )

    - name: Run tests
      run: php -d error_reporting=E_ALL test/run.php --all

  build-24:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    strategy:
      matrix:
        php-versions: ['8.1', '8.5']
        db_image: ['mariadb:10.11', 'mysql:8.0']

    services:
      db:
        image: ${{ matrix.db_image }}
        env:
          MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: root
        ports:
          - '3306:3306'
        options: >-
          --health-cmd="mysqladmin ping -h 127.0.0.1 -proot --silent"
          --health-interval=10s
          --health-timeout=5s
          --health-retries=10

    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v7

    - name: Prepare the application
      run: |
        DBHOST_FLAG=
        if [ ! -S /var/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock ]; then
          echo '$Opt["dbHost"] = "127.0.0.1";' >> test/options.php
          echo '$Opt["dbHost"] = "127.0.0.1";' >> test/cdb-options.php
          mv test/options.php test/options.php~
          sed 's/@localhost/@127.0.0.1/' < test/options.php~ > test/options.php
          DBHOST_FLAG="--grant-host=%"
        fi
        sudo lib/createdb.sh -u root -proot $DBHOST_FLAG -c test/options.php --batch --verbose
        sudo lib/createdb.sh -u root -proot $DBHOST_FLAG -c test/cdb-options.php --no-dbuser --no-schema --batch --verbose

    - name: Set up PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
      with:
        php-version: ${{ matrix.php-versions }}
        extensions: mbstring, intl, mysqlnd
        ini-values: opcache.enable_cli=1

    - name: Install poppler
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update --allow-releaseinfo-change
        sudo apt-get --fix-missing install poppler-utils

    - name: Run tests
      run: php -d error_reporting=E_ALL test/run.php --all
